messages:
Oncall Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: high error rates and elevated p99 latency for inference route /v1/chat (host pool-a). Alert: kvcache_miss_rate > 0.45 for 5m. Pager ID: pager-1767809123
Maria G: I'm on it. Summary please and impact (customer-facing routes)?
Raj P: Looking at traces—root cause looks like a spike in KV cache evictions from recent eviction-policy bump. Misses cause longer KV fetchs and backpressure into batching code -> p99 token latencies. Customers affected: a handful of high-throughput prod tenants (acct ids s-102, s-213).
Lee S: Confirming increased queueing on worker nodes, several 10-15s stalls on token generation. Host CPU pegged in the hot path.
Sofia T: Any rollout or config changes recently?
Raj P: Yes, autoscaler/evict-policy change deployed 2h ago from rollout 1767804000. Patch changed soft-evict threshold from 0.75 -> 0.5 to free memory. Suspect regression with quantized KV memory accounting.
Maria G: Triage plan: (1) mitigate to reduce customer impact, (2) collect full traces & logs, (3) schedule postmortem and action items. Who can run the quick mitigation?
Lee S: I can run hotfix. Proposing: revert eviction-threshold to 0.75 for pool-a and enable transient burst capacity. Steps: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/kv-agent EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.75` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/kv-agent` and scale nodes: `k scale nodepool pool-a --replicas=6`
Infra-Bot: Executed: increased nodepool pool-a to 6 replicas (change-id infra-3821).
Raj P: Also a short-term runtime bypass: disable quant fast-path that undercounts KV references: feature flag `ENABLE_QUANT_FASTPATH=false` on runtime nodes. That prevents wrong mem accounting while we debug.
Maria G: Make that change in staging first and then prod. Lee, can you do prod after staging check?
Lee S: Doing staging now. Patch applied to staging runtime-01. Observing immediate drop in miss_rate to 0.12.
Sofia T: Noted customer impact threads: s-102 opened support ticket SUP-784; engineering liaison pinged.
Maria G: Deploying to prod in 10. Keep updates short.
Lee S: Applied `ENABLE_QUANT_FASTPATH=false` to prod runtime group A. kvcache_miss_rate down to 0.09 within 3m. p99 latency back to baseline.
Raj P: Collected heap profiles and KV metrics for the period 1767807000-1767809100, uploaded to /mnt/logs/kvcache/1767809 (link: https://logs.internal/r/1767809)
Maria G: Customer-impact summary: ~4 tenants saw elevated latencies for ~45-70 minutes. No data lost. We applied two mitigations: revert eviction threshold and disable quant fast-path. Both reduced impact.
Sofia T: Scheduling postmortem: I created doc draft at https://docs.internal/postmortems/inference-kvcache-1767809123. Suggested owners: Raj (root cause + repro), Lee (mitigation/runbook), Maria (postmortem writeup and customer comms). Due EOD +3 (1768060000).
Raj P: Action items I will own: (A) repro locally and instrument quant mem accounting (PR: github.com/rw/infra/pull/4912), (B) add e2e test simulating quantized KV refcounts (JIRA INF-1293). ETA 5d.
Lee S: My action items: (A) update runbook to include quick rollback commands and flag locations, (B) add a safepoint that disables evictions when miss_rate > 0.3 and latency > 1s (PR: github.com/rw/serving/pull/3107). ETA 3d.
Maria G: I'll coordinate customer comms and postmortem publication. Also add follow-up to weekly SRE review.
Infra-Bot: Note: autoscaler change 1767804000 flagged; rolling back policy in infra-configs (change ticket infra-3822).
Sofia T: Quick checklist for postincident follow-ups: 1) Assign owners (done), 2) Attach traces + logs (Raj uploaded), 3) Link PRs & JIRAs (Raj/Lee to create), 4) Schedule postmortem meeting — proposing tomorrow 10:30 PT. Anyone blocked?
Raj P: Fine for 10:30 PT.
Lee S: Fine.
Maria G: Added calendar invite. Also adding a customer-facing summary for support to paste: "We experienced elevated inference latencies due to a runtime KV-cache eviction policy change that increased cache misses under quantized models. We reverted the policy and applied a temporary runtime flag; engineers are implementing a permanent fix. No data loss."
Sofia T: One more follow-up: add an alert runbook entry to route similar p99 spikes to oncall + paging priority P0 with immediate rollback checklist.
Maria G: Agreed. Adding to runbook and creating ticket INF-1294 for alert+runbook.
Lee S: After-action note: I saw a correlated GC spike on a subset of quantized model hosts — might be addressing mem-accounting bug. I'll capture heap dumps for the next repro attempt.
Raj P: I'll add additional instrumentation counters for kv_refcounts and quant_allocs before enabling fast-path again.
Maria G: Closing live mitigation – system stable and metrics normal for 20m. Will keep thread open for postmortem edits. :white_check_mark:
Sofia T: Thanks everyone. Adding tags: postmortem-scheduled, customer-impact, kvcache, quantization
Oncall Bot: Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. Pager closed (pager-1767809123).
